instructions: Player-facing prose: Jam owns data/player-copy.json; keep board in sync on Save.

items.ability: Atk 3, or Atk 1 and Keep this item
items.name: Throwing Knife

items.ability: Gain 4 Block.
items.name: Shield

items.ability: Flips 2 ↔ 4 after each Item used.
items.name: Sai
items.notes: This should NOT start at 2 each fight, it should carry over its value between combats (not between dungeons eg adventure mode)

items.ability: +1 Block for each HP you are missing.
items.name: Medallion

items.ability: Block equal to the lower HP between you and the Enemy.
items.explainer: (Lower of YOUR HP or ENEMY HP)
items.flow: Lower HP wins; player value if tied. Recheck on HP change either side.
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with fewer HP than you (not equal).
items.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.log_hint: Kill if they have less HP
items.name: The Boot

items.ability: 1 Attack, plus 1 for each HP you are missing.
items.name: Bloody Wraps

items.ability: Block equal to the Neighboring enemy's Attack on the Right.
items.flow: On use, gain Block equal to the Attack of the neighboring enemy on your right. Unusable with no neighbor there.
items.name: Right Bracer
items.notes: Final enemy: unusable.

items.ability: Block equal to the Neighboring enemy's Attack on the Left.
items.flow: On use, gain Block equal to the Attack of the neighboring enemy on your left. Unusable with no neighbor there.
items.name: Left Bracer
items.notes: Final enemy: unusable.

items.ability: Attack equal to 8 minus the Items still in your hand.
items.flow: Also describes HP Delta (absolute difference of player vs enemy HP).
items.name: Knucklers

items.ability: This gains +2 Attack each time you lose any HP.
items.name: Spiked Flail
items.notes: Change to Base 0 ATK

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with 6 or more Attack. Combat ends immediately.
items.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.name: Sledgehammer

items.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the last monster you spun.
items.flow: On Spin, store enemy ATK. Initial value is always 0.
items.name: Grimoire

items.ability: Gain 2 Block. If you lose HP this combat, Keep this Item.
items.flow: Tap on use. Discard on resolve unless HP dropped vs On Spin. Healing Potion this combat makes Did Lose HP always True.
items.name: Breastplate

items.ability: Spin again and gain a Random Item.
items.flow: End combat without resolving. Spin again, not the same slice. Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic.
items.name: Smoke Bomb

items.ability: Let the Enemy Attack, then Defeat them and Heal equal to their current HP.
items.flow: Store enemy HP on use. Fangs DMG can be blocked like Resolve Combat. Then heal stored HP. Player HP never exceeds 6. If this would kill you: Healing Potion, then Fangs Healing.
items.name: Fangs

items.ability: Mark a Neighbor with 4 Poison.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click a living Neighbor. Used up. They gain 4 Poison. Amounts add. Plague Doctor neighbors stay at 2. On the next Spin, every monster with Poison loses that much HP immediately, wherever they sit, then the mark clears. This is before their spin ability. If it kills them, that ability does not happen. They stay in the seat until the other spin abilities finish. A dead monster who is not the one you landed on then leaves and the seat fills. If the one you landed on died, the fight ends after those abilities. Lose HP is not Attack (can kill Goblin). Anvil loses only 1 from this one source. Unusable with 0 neighbors. Crossbow-marked neighbors are not choosable.
items.name: Poison Flask

items.ability: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3.
items.flow: If player HP ever equals 0, immediately Discard this item and set the player's HP to 4.
items.name: Healing Potion

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to a Neighboring enemy.
items.flow: On use, choose a neighboring enemy. Deal 4 attack damage to them. If their HP reaches 0, they are defeated immediately. Unusable with 0 eligible neighbors.
items.name: Crossbow

items.ability: Target any enemy. That enemy attacks the monster that is Across from them.
items.explainer: Pick any monster. They Attack the monster Across from them. Unplayable when the number of monsters is odd.
items.name: Pocketwatch
items.notes: Odd living-monster count: unusable. Across skips empty corridors and walks the living monsters.

items.ability: Deal 2 Attack to the enemy you are facing and each Neighboring enemy. The same enemy is only hit once.
items.flow: On use, deal 2 ATK to the facing owner and each unique living neighbor. Two owners left: the other takes 2 once. Goblin ignores ATK. Used up.
items.name: Great Axe

items.ability: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated
items.flow: On use in a fight, heal 1 + mobs_defeated, cap at 6 HP. Used up. Healing Potion still revives on death.
items.name: Victory Flask

items.ability: Move to Any Monster, then Draw 1 Item
items.explainer: Walk the short way to that monster. Draw 1 Item. Does not spend a Move.
items.flow: On use, pick a living neighbor. Swap that owner with the facing owner. Keep current block, items-used, and snapshots. Draw one item from the remaining pool if any. Used up.
items.name: Grappling Hook

items.ability: 3 Attack or 3 Block. Alternates on Item Use
items.explainer: (Attack 3) or (Block 3), then the other after each Item
items.flow: Click during a fight. The card is already showing Attack 3 or Block 3. You do not pick. Attack 3 hits the monster you face, then the card is used up. Block 3 adds 3 Block, then the card is used up. Every item use flips the face, including this click and including a different item used while this card is still in hand. An unspent card keeps that face into the next fight. A new dungeon starts it on Attack 3. While it shows Attack, it counts as an Attack item. While it shows Block, it counts as a Block item.
items.log_hint: Attack 3 or Block 3, flips after each Item
items.name: Spiked Shield
items.notes: Art is a stand-in until a spiked shield tile exists.

items.ability: Each time you Spin, Lose 1 HP and this item gains +2 Block
items.flow: While in hand and not spent: at combat start, player loses 1 HP (counts as a bleed for Spiked Flail) and this card's block number +2. On use, gain that much block, then used up. Starts at 0.
items.log_hint: Each Spin: lose HP, gain Block
items.name: Grief Jar

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to the monster across from you (only works if even # of monsters remaining)
items.flow: Usable in a fight only when living slice count is even. Deal 4 ATK to the opposite slice. Goblin ignores ATK. Odd count: cannot use. Used up.
items.name: Longbow

items.ability: Heal 1, then increase this number by 1. Keep this if you are still missing HP.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Heal 2, cap 6. If HP is still below 6, keep the card. If you are already at 6, heal 0 and the card is used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Lantern
items.notes: Breastplate keeps if you bled. This keeps if you are still hurt after the heal.

items.ability: Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained this dungeon. If you have not gained Block yet this dungeon, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Mirror Shard
items.notes: Last Block is the amount from the last time you gained Block, not your current Block total.

items.ability: Becomes a copy of the last item you used.
items.flow: In hand this looks like the last item you used this dungeon (faint Echo icon). Click it to use that copy, then Echo is used up even if the original had Keep. If you have not used an item this dungeon, it is Unplayable.
items.name: Echo Bell
items.notes: Updates when you use an item. Cube feed is not an item use. First fight of a run: Unplayable.

items.ability: Remove your Enemy's unique ability
items.flow: Click during a fight. That owner id loses its unique ability and formulas for the rest of this dungeon. They show printed ATK/HP like Golem. If they have no unique ability, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up otherwise.
items.name: Quiet Bell
items.notes: Golem: cannot click. Bandit and other formulas fall back to the ATK/HP columns.

items.ability: Choose to reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click 1, 2, or 3. Facing Attack drops by that much after every other formula including Commander, floors at 0, then locks for the rest of this fight. Used up.
items.name: Net
items.notes: Caltrops is retired. This is the milder version, last in calc.

items.ability: Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. Keep this item.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. You keep that Block. This item Keeps. Unplayable at 0 Block. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.name: Chain
items.notes: Hornet and Queen still Attack after. You still hold the Block for those swings.

items.ability: (1), (2), (3), or (4) Atk. Changes on Item use
items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to the dungeon cycle number (1, then 2, then 3, then 4, then 1). Every item use this dungeon advances that number, including this click. The cycle carries across fights and resets on the next dungeon. Two Beads share one number. Used up. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.name: Counting Beads
items.notes: Cube feed is not an item use, so the cycle does not advance. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack.

items.ability: If you have no playable items that Attack, Defeat the enemy.
items.flow: Click during a fight. If you hold no playable items that Attack, Defeat them. Chakram counts while its Attack half is live. Petrified and spent items do not count. This card is not an Attack item. Unplayable if any other playable card in hand deals Attack. Used up when it works. Counts as an item use. Gargoyle cannot be Defeated.
items.log_hint: Win if you have no Attack
items.name: Paci-Fist
items.notes: Holding only this works. Echo copying an Attack item counts as an Attack item. Shield alone is enough.

items.ability: Defeat Any Monster with exactly double your HP
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click any monster on the wheel (including the one you are facing). If that monster's HP is exactly twice yours, Defeat them. If they are not the one you are fighting, they leave and this fight keeps going. Grey if nobody matches. Same animation as The Boot and Sledgehammer. Used up.
items.name: Scythe

items.ability: Choose 2 Items and Swap them.
items.defined: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item that can Swap, Swap that one. If you hold two or more that can Swap, pick two. Each Swap exchanges that card for a random leftover copy of the same rank from the draft pile and returns the old card to the pile. You cannot Swap into a card with no remaining count. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if nothing can Swap. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item, reroll that one. If you hold two or more, pick two. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier, with the same motion as Adventure Mode starter upgrades. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if this is the only item in your hand. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Chaos Stone
items.notes: Does not deal Attack. Gargoyle petrify does not pick this. Cube feed is not this.

items.ability: Heal 6. On Spin, lose 1 HP.
items.flow: While in inventory unused, Lose 1 HP On Spin after combat has begun. Counts as Did Lose HP for Breastplate.
items.name: Cursed Scroll

items.ability: Choose Highest Attack, Lowest Attack, or Off. The next Spin lands on that monster, then discard this.
items.flow: Click at Ready or during a fight. Three pills: Highest Attack, Lowest Attack, Off. Highest or Lowest arms this copy. Off clears the arm. Attack numbers are read at Spin after formulas. Ties pick at random among those Attack values. The next Spin (button, auto-spin after a fight, Smoke Bomb, Commander flee, Wick, Vampire shuffle) lands on that monster, then this copy is discarded. Tutorial scripted landings ignore it and do not discard it. Two copies: the most recently set Highest or Lowest wins; copies armed that way are discarded; the other mode stays. Quiet Bell does not turn this off. Not in the tutorial kit.
items.name: Danger Magnet
items.notes: Bucket 4. Count 1. No Attack. Petrified still steers if already armed.

items.ability: Take 2 Attack. If you still hold this when you Spin Spider Queen, discard it; she gains +2 HP and +2 Attack.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Take 2 Attack; Block works. Used up. If this is in hand when the wheel lands on Spider Queen, discard it and she gains +2 HP and +2 Attack. Queen does not create an Egg on the Spin that lands on her. Always created on other Spins while Queen is alive, up to 50 cards in hand.
items.log_hint: Hurt you, or feed the Queen
items.name: Spider Egg
items.notes: Not drafted. Queen creates it. Tier 0 so Merchant can turn it into a Tier 1 item.

items.ability: The facing owner's Attack becomes 0 this fight.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Set facing Attack to 0 and lock it for the rest of this fight, including after Commander and Harpy formulas. They still leave after Done. Used up.
items.name: Caltrops
items.notes: Dragon pierce of 0 is 0. Kobold still swings twice for 0.

items.ability: (ATK 2), then return to your hand.
items.flow: Do not discard on use; Tap. Untap always occurs On Resolve Combat.
items.name: Dagger

items.ability: (BLK X), where X is the lowest HP between you and the enemy.
items.flow: Older check: only enemy HP change, not player HP. Hidden/retired.
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP.
items.name: Bandana

items.ability: 6 Atk and Lose 2 HP.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal 6 Attack to the owner you spun. Then Lose 2 HP (Block does not stop it; Spiked Flail and Pacemaker see it). You still Lose 2 if that Attack Defeats them. Goblin takes 0 and you still Lose 2. Used up. Counts as an item use. No pierce aura. Tutorial does not seat it.
items.name: Arrow Head

items.ability: Move →, then Attack 3.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. If another living monster is on the wheel, shift to the neighbor up and to the right (counter-clockwise, the same way as the Move-right button) without Spinning. This does not spend an adventure Move. Then deal 3 Attack to whoever you are facing. If they are the only living monster, skip the shift and deal 3 to them. No Keep. Goblin ignores Attack. Needleback, Harpy, Anvil, and Prism apply to whoever takes the hit.
items.name: Shuriken
items.notes: Move up-right, then 3 Attack. One living monster: no Move, the 3 still hits. No Keep.

items.ability: Apply Poison to all Monsters equal to the lowest HP on any Monster
items.flow: Click during a fight. Read current HP of every living monster, take the lowest, add that much Poison to every living monster. Plague Doctor neighbors stay at 2. Nothing is paid when you play this. On the next Spin, every monster with Poison loses that much HP, wherever they sit, then the mark clears. Fight only. Used up.
items.log_hint: Poison everyone for the lowest HP
items.name: Miasma
items.notes: Bucket 4. Poison sources add. Flask is +5 on a neighbor.

items.ability: Fill your inventory with Marbles
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. Then fill empty seats with Marble tokens until the hand has 10 cards, even in the 50-seat dungeon. Fight only.
items.name: Bag of Marbles
items.notes: Bucket 3. Marble is a Token, not drafted.

items.ability: Gain 0 Atk or 0 Block randomly. On Spin, increase these numbers by 1
items.flow: Token. Not an Attack item until it declares Attack. Click during a fight: a callout names Attack or Block at random, then that number fires. 0 can be clicked and is used up. Each Marble has its own number starting at 0. Every Spin each Marble in hand +1. New dungeon resets to 0. Used up on click.
items.log_hint: Random Attack or Block, grows on Spin
items.name: Marble
items.notes: Created by Bag of Marbles. Merchant treats Tier 0 like Egg.

items.ability: Unplayable. Defeats the Monster 6 Spins from now.
items.flow: Unplayable. Starts at 6. Every Spin (Smoke, Flee, auto-spin, landing) the number drops by 1. At 1 it flashes red. On the Spin that hits 0, Defeat the landed enemy with no HP chip (like The Boot). Gargoyle is Defeated. Commander can still Flee. Two Hexes at 0 both spend, one Defeat. Poison is paid before Hex. If that poison already killed the monster you landed on, Hex does not count down and does not Defeat. New dungeon resets to 6. Used up when it fires.
items.name: Hex
items.notes: Bucket 6. Skull + number on the card.

items.ability: Heal yourself and the Enemy for 3 HP. Then draw an Item.
items.explainer: Heal 3 (you and the Enemy), then draw an Item
items.flow: SP-29 (2026-10-25). Click during a fight. Used up. Heal yourself 3 (cap 6) and Heal the Enemy 3 (cap at their max HP). Then draw one random Item from the current loot pool, the same draw Catapult and Grappling Hook use. No Poison.
items.log_hint: Heal 3 each, then draw an Item
items.name: Ale Flagon
items.notes: SP-29. Shared heal. Draw is a random loot-pool Item. No Poison.

items.ability: Set the HP of the Enemy, its Neighbors, and yourself to 1 HP
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. Not Attack. Block does not apply. Bleed each target for (current HP − 1) in one loss event, stopping at 1. Order: facing Enemy, then left neighbor (clockwise), then right neighbor (counter-clockwise), then you. Skip a neighbor at 0 HP (no revive). Already at 1 loses 0. Anvil goes to 1 anyway. Losing HP still triggers Ogre, Vampire, Spiked Flail, Cowardly King. Coward Attacks when they lose HP (you still have HP and Block); Flee waits until this item finishes. Fight only.
items.name: Napalm
items.notes: Bucket 6. Fire storm art. Same Bleed as Cursed Scroll, not Attack.

items.ability: Gain 2 Block, or Gain 6 Block and Lose 2 HP. Keep.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Gain 1 Block. Then if your Block total is even, Keep (spent this fight, still in your hand for later fights, same as Lantern). If odd, used up. Twins only doubles even Block gains, so this 1 is not doubled. Basilisk still blocks Keep. Block resets to 0 each fight, so a first click at 0 becomes 1 (odd) and is used up unless you already held odd Block. Fight only. Not Attack.
items.log_hint: Block 1, Keep if Block is even
items.name: Lucky Nickel
items.notes: Bucket 7. Coin with Grandpa goblin's face. Not Attack.

items.ability: If enemy Attack is Even, this Blocks for half of it.
items.explainer: Block half of an even Attack.
items.flow: Never click this. Listens like Healing Potion. The next enemy Attack whose ATK number is even (2, 4, 6…) and would deal more than 0 after Block/pierce: mid-swing, cut that ATK in half (floor), then apply Block. Discard. 0 ATK and fully blocked even ATK do not fire. Spider Egg is not an enemy. Hornet/Damsel/Kobold/Shambling Mound: waits for the first even swing in that burst, then later swings are full. Two copies: first even spends one. Petrify still listens. Potion can still save if the halved hit kills you.
items.log_hint: Halve the next even enemy Attack
items.name: Double-Buckler
items.notes: Bucket 2. Two round bucklers. Unplayable. Not Egg, not Poison.

items.ability: You and your Enemy lose 2 HP
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. You lose 2 HP and the facing enemy loses 2 HP. Not Attack: Block does not stop it, Goblin takes it, Flail ticks. Anvil still max 1. Both chips happen even if you would hit 0; Healing Potion can save you. If they hit 0, they are Defeated. If you hit 0 and Potion does not save, you die. Not drafted. Cultist creates it. Tier 0 so Merchant can turn it into a Tier 1 item.
items.log_hint: You and the enemy lose 2 HP
items.name: Blood Pact
items.notes: Token. Not drafted. Cultist creates it. Black card like Egg. HP chip, not Attack.

items.ability: Move 2 in a random direction, and Keep this.
items.explainer: Two steps in one random direction. Your Moves stay. Tapped until you Spin.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Heal 2 (cap 6). The Jar is used up. While it is still in your hand, one Move spends 1 move and slides two seats in that direction. If the second seat has no living monster, you only slide one.
items.name: Jar O' Grease
items.notes: Bucket 2. On use Heal 2. Passive extra seat on Move while held. Swap and Keep are gone.

items.ability: Unplayable. On Item Use, decrease this by 1. When this reaches 0, Die.
items.flow: Unplayable token. Starts at 6. Each item use that increments the Beads counter lowers the number by 1. At 1 it pulses. At 0: Die, Healing Potion can save. Overlay picks (Cube, Worm, Merchant, Bell spawn/defeat) do not tick. Bushido dummy throw does tick. Potion auto and Buckler auto do not. Stays between fights until dumped or it hits 0. Curse: Cube, Worm, Bell, Hired Hand, and a full-hand replace cannot dump it. Merchant can still upgrade it.
items.name: Toll
items.notes: Token. Not drafted. Death Bell creates it. Black card like Egg. Starts at 6.

items.ability: When you lose exactly 2 HP, Heal 1. On Use, Lose 2 HP.
items.flow: While this is in your hand unspent, each time you lose exactly 2 HP in one event, Heal 1. Click during a fight: Lose 2 HP (that also Heals 1), then this is used up. Fight only.
items.log_hint: Use: Lose 2 HP. Exact-2 loss: Heal 1
items.name: Pacemaker
items.notes: Needs art.

items.ability: Eject your Enemy. Draw an Item.
items.flow: Challenge only. Click during a fight. Used up. The facing enemy leaves with no loot and Wick does not chip. They go to the bottom of the dungeon deck with permanent HP/ATK/poison. The empty seat fills from the deck; that arrival still gives you an item. War Cry-style passives do not stay as a number.
items.log_hint: Eject facing enemy, draw an Item
items.name: Catapult
items.notes: Challenge only. Needs art.

items.ability: Turn your opponent into an exact copy of a Neighbor of your choice.
items.explainer: Copy a Neighbor onto the enemy you face.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click a living Neighbor. Used up. The facing enemy becomes that Neighbor’s card (name, art, ability) with that Neighbor’s current HP, max HP, ATK minus Commander aura, and marked poison. Seat auras recalculate. No Neighbor: unplayable.
items.log_hint: Facing enemy becomes a copy of a chosen Neighbor
items.name: Polymorph
items.notes: Spell scroll depicting a fluffy sheep. Needs art.

items.ability: Block 10. Retain leftover block from this combat.
items.explainer: (BLK 10) leftover stays for the next fight
items.flow: Click during a fight. Gain 10 Block. Used up. Leftover Block after this fight stays for the next fight only, then clears.
items.log_hint: Block 10, leftover remains for the next fight
items.name: Stone Wall
items.notes: Needs art.

items.ability: Heal equal to the amount of HP you most recently lose.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. Heal equal to the last HP-loss event this dungeon. If you have not lost HP yet, unplayable.
items.log_hint: Heal equal to last HP lost
items.name: Blood Chalice
items.notes: Needs art.

items.ability: Block 3 if you have no playable Items that Block. Attack 3 if you have no playable Items that Attack.
items.explainer: (BLK 3 if no playable Block Items)  (ATK 3 if no playable Attack Items)
items.flow: Click during a fight. Used up. Realtime check of the rest of the hotbar: if no other item Grants Block, Gain 3 Block. If no other item deals Attack, deal 3 Attack. One click can do one or both. Other Chakrams do not count. Petrified items and Bushido dummy (or similar silencing) do not count. Marble counts as both, including at 0. Double-Buckler does not count (it does not Grant Block). An item that would Block or Attack for 0 still counts. Grey / unplayable only when both a Block item and an Attack item are sitting unmuted in the hotbar.
items.log_hint: Block 3 and/or Attack 3 if the rest of the hand has none
items.name: Chakram
items.notes: Tier 2. Circular throwing blade. Needs unique art at assets/dungeon/items/chakram.png.

items.ability: Block 7, then choose a Neighbor to Attack you
items.log_hint: Block 7, then a Neighbor Attacks you
items.name: Signpost
items.notes: Tier 1. Wooden road sign. Paper Fight before ops.

items.ability: Select an Attack. It can target Any monster. Draw 1 Item
items.explainer: Select an Attack. It can target Any monster. Draw 1 Item
items.flow: Click during a fight. Unplayable if no other item in the hotbar deals Attack. Pick one Attack item. That attack can target Any living monster. Great Axe hits that monster and that monster Neighbors. After that Attack resolves, draw 1 Item from the item deck into the hotbar (same draw as Catapult). No draw if you cancel or if there is no Attack to select.
items.name: Sling
items.notes: Tier 1. Leather sling. Bucket 6 (after Bag of Marbles). Draws 1 Item after the chosen Attack resolves.

items.ability: Bag an enemy with less HP than you.
items.explainer: (ENEMY HP < YOUR HP). They go in the bag.
items.flow: Click during a fight, on the owner you spun, like The Boot. Empty bag: if their current HP is less than yours, they leave the wheel (no Phoenix / Gargoyle / Commander / Triclops / Wick / Death Bell on this capture) and this card stays, renamed Bag of that monster, with their sprite and the HP they had. Later uses: if the new owner has less HP than the number on the bag, they replace whoever was inside. Bagged counts as Defeated for Mimic gift and kill counters. When the wheel has 0 owners, before a clear, the bag is discarded and the latest captive sits back down as they were. You no longer have the bag, so you cannot bag them with this card again. Unused bag does nothing at a clear.
items.log_hint: Bag if less HP; they come back at the end
items.name: Bag of Holding
items.notes: Shopping-list hole 01. Pixel: open burlap sack with purple portal; closed sack with room for a monster stamp.

items.ability: 2 Atk. The next time you or an Enemy would Flee, cancel it and this gains +2 Atk.
items.explainer: (ATK 2. Whenever you or an Enemy would Flee, cancel it. This gains +2 Attack.)
items.flow: Sits at Attack 2. Click during a fight to deal its current Attack to the owner you spun, then it is discarded. Whenever you or an Enemy would Flee, that Flee does not happen, a Can't Flee banner shows this card, and its Attack goes up by 2. That can happen again on a later Flee. A petrified copy does not interrupt. Two copies both gain +2. Commander cancelled Flee: they are not Defeated, they do not go to full HP, they stay at the HP they had before that Attack. Phoenix / Egg still transform in this seat. Triclops still lose 2 HP and stay. Basilisk still Petrifies, then stays if this is not petrified.
items.name: Ball & Chain
items.notes: Shopping-list hole 02. Pixel: prison ball and chain, black iron.

items.ability: Every 5th Item Discarded is copied into your Hand
items.explainer: (Every 5th Discard copies that Item into your Hand.)
items.flow: Unplayable watcher. Drafts at 5. Each real Discard ticks it down. Use and successful Keep do not tick. Bell, Cube, Worm, bribe, failed Keep, and the bag emptying do. A full-hand replace (click a card to make room) does not. At 1 it flashes: the next Discard is copied into the hand as that same card (Grief Jar keeps its stored Block). Recycler stays and resets to 5. If Recycler itself is discarded at 1, it comes back at 5. Two Recyclers at 1 make two copies. Extra copies that will not fit the hand are lost (Can't Gain). Recycler still resets.
items.name: Recycler
items.notes: Shopping-list hole 03. Pixel: large recycle icon on a steel plate.

items.ability: Enemies ignore your Block for 3 Spins
items.flow: Unplayable token. Starts at 3. While it sits, all monsters ignore your Block (same pierce as Arrow Head). Each Spin, including the first after it enters your hand: 3 → 2 → 1 → Discard after the third fight. Curse: Cube, Worm, Bell, Hired Hand, and a full-hand replace cannot dump it. Recycler ticks Discards that still happen.
items.log_hint: Unplayable. Ignore Block for 3 Spins, then Discard.
items.name: Rust
items.notes: Token. Not drafted. Rust Bucket creates it. Broken shield + countdown.

items.ability: Heal 2.
items.flow: SP-23 token. Not drafted. Fairy creates it when Defeated without losing HP. Click during a fight. Heal 2 (cap 6). Used up.
items.name: Fairy in a Bottle
items.notes: Token. Not drafted. Fairy creates it. Needs art.

items.ability: Defeat your enemy if you are perfectly Blocking them, and Gain a Marble equal to their Attack
items.explainer: If Safe, Defeat them. Gain a Marble of their Attack.
items.flow: Click during a fight on the enemy you are facing, like The Boot. Grey unless incoming damage after Block is 0, the same total the Safe button uses.
items.log_hint: Safe: Defeat them. Marble of their Attack.
items.name: Orb
items.notes: Pool 4, tier 2, Cheese. Crystal magic focus orb. Grey unless Safe. Marble number is their Attack, copied once. All tokens leave the hand when the dungeon ends.

items.ability: Flee, then Gain 5 Block
items.flow: Click during a fight. No target. Used up. The monster you are facing stays, and the wheel spins. On Spin effects for the monster you land on happen next. Then Gain 5 Block. Block you already had clears on the Flee. Ball and Chain stops the Flee: Gain 5 Block, the card is discarded, and this fight stays open.
items.name: Flying Saucer
items.notes: Tier 2. Defense. Art: a dinner saucer turned into a flying UFO.

monsters.explainer: plain ATK/HP Owner
monsters.name: Golem

monsters.ability: I cannot take Attack damage.
monsters.flow: This unit's HP can never be reduced. Note that this unit can be defeated through all other means.
monsters.name: Goblin
monsters.reminder: Immune to Attacks

monsters.ability: I copy the HP of the last enemy you faced.
monsters.explainer: last enemy HP
monsters.flow: On Spin (and after On Spin effects, especially Spider Queen's Egg effect or Ogre's Empath updates), immediately store the enemy's HP in this value. Overwrite each On Spin.
monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.notes: If this is the first unit faced, set HP to 3.
monsters.reminder: last enemy HP

monsters.ability: I Attack twice.
monsters.explainer: Attacks twice
monsters.flow: On Resolve Combat, takes its current ATK and deals dmg to the player two times. There should be no special or unique interaction with BLK, this should attack in a logically consistent way to if two enemies simply attacked the player, one after the other. For example, the player may actually BLEED twice if both attacks cause the player to lose health.
monsters.name: Hornet Swarm
monsters.reminder: Attacks twice

monsters.ability: When you use Defeat Items against me, they fail, reduce my HP by 1, and are Kept. I cannot lose HP in any other way.
monsters.explainer: Legal Defeat items chip 1 HP and stay Kept. Nothing else lowers my HP.
monsters.flow: Pool 3, tier 2, 2 HP, 5 Attack. A Defeat item must already be legally usable (Paci-Fist still needs no Attack items; Sledgehammer still needs 6 or more Attack). The Boot, Sledgehammer, Fangs, Paci-Fist, Scythe, and Hex are the Defeat items. On use against me the Defeat does not happen: I lose 1 HP and that item is Kept and tapped until the fight ends. Echo Bell's copy is still used up. Fangs still makes me attack, then chips 1, and Heals you for the HP I had before that chip. Two Hexes at 0 each chip 1 and both reset to 6 and stay. I cannot lose HP any other way. Quiet Bell turns this off. If I still have HP, I attack at the end of combat and I am defeated as normal.
monsters.name: Lich
monsters.notes: Neighbor aura moved to Fairy.
monsters.reminder: Defeat chips 1. No other HP loss.

monsters.ability: When you lose HP, I lose equal HP.
monsters.explainer: HP is yours
monsters.name: Ogre

monsters.ability: Every time you lose HP, I gain +1 HP and +1 Attack.
monsters.explainer: +1 HP and +1 Attack each time you lose HP
monsters.flow: Each time the player's HP number goes down, every living Vampire on the wheel gains +1 current HP, +1 max HP, and +1 Attack. A 4-heart hit is still +1/+1. A fully blocked hit does nothing. Healing does not remove the bonus. The bonus stays until that Vampire dies or leaves. Quiet Bell stops further gains and keeps the HP and Attack already gained. The new Attack is for the next swing.
monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.notes: Once per hit or bleed, not once per heart. Every copy on the wheel.
monsters.reminder: +1/+1 each time you lose HP

monsters.ability: On Spin, 50%: gain +4 Attack. Otherwise: lose 3 Attack.
monsters.explainer: 50% +4 Attack, otherwise lose 3 Attack
monsters.flow: SP-22 (2026-10-25). Every Spin, each living unsilenced Berserker rolls. 50%: that copy's Attack gains +4. Otherwise it loses 3 Attack. The change stacks. Attack clamps at 0 (further losses do not go negative; the next gain starts from 0). Commander still adds after this. Separate + and − animations.
monsters.name: Berserker
monsters.notes: SP-22. Every Spin. Stacks. Attack clamps at 0.

monsters.ability: My Attack always equals your HP.
monsters.explainer: Attack always equals your HP
monsters.name: Dire Wolf
monsters.reminder: Attack always equals your HP

monsters.ability: +1 Atk for each Item you hold.
monsters.explainer: Attack = Your Items
monsters.name: Bandit

monsters.ability: My Neighbors will attack you (Left, then Right), then I will Heal you for 3 HP.
monsters.explainer: Neighbors attack, then Heal 3
monsters.name: Damsel in Distress

monsters.ability: My Attack always equals my HP.
monsters.explainer: Attack equals HP
monsters.name: Slime Boss
monsters.notes: Only unit whose ATK can change mid-combat. Damaging it affects Sai, Fangs, Sledgehammer.

monsters.ability: On Spin, repeatedly Heals the Lowest HP Monster until it equals the HP of another Monster.
monsters.explainer: Lowest HP Monster +1 until tied with another
monsters.log_hint: Raises lowest HP Monster until it equals another Monster
monsters.name: Leech League
monsters.reminder: Lowest HP Monster = 2nd Lowest HP Monster

monsters.ability: When I am Defeated, set your HP to my most recent HP.
monsters.explainer: Defeated: set your HP to my most recent HP
monsters.flow: SP-26 (2026-10-25). Display name stays Wraith. Id stays wraith. 2 HP / 4 Attack, tier 2. When I am Defeated, set your HP to my HP just before the defeating event. One killing hit from 2 uses 2. Several hits use the HP before the last hit. A defeat item or blocking then leaving uses the HP I still have. Lower HP is losing HP (Bleed). Higher HP is a heal. Equal does nothing. Cap at 6. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: Defeated: your HP becomes my last HP
monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.notes: SP-26. Display name stays Wraith. Id stays wraith. No id migration.

monsters.ability: If I go down before I Attack, you gain an Item.
monsters.explainer: Item if I never swing
monsters.flow: Did It Attack? starts False. Set True if the enemy ever attacks. Prevent by killing or defeating with items (not blocking). Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic. If pool empty, draw nothing.
monsters.log_hint: Drops an item if you kill it
monsters.name: Mimic

monsters.ability: Each time you Spin, Gain 1 Spider Egg. Spinning me discards those eggs; I gain +2 HP and +2 Attack for each.
monsters.explainer: Spider Egg: an Item that on use deals you 2 Atk, or is devoured by the Queen to give her +2 HP and +2 ATK
monsters.flow: (Changed) Only attacks once, no more double attack.
monsters.log_hint: Gives you an Egg each Spin
monsters.name: Spider Queen

monsters.ability: I give my Neighbors +2 Attack. The first time I am Defeated, I Flee and the wheel Spins at random.
monsters.explainer: Neighbors +2 Attack
monsters.flow: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.
monsters.name: Commander

monsters.ability: My Attack ignores Block.
monsters.explainer: ignores Block
monsters.name: Dragon

monsters.ability: I Attack you for 2 Damage each time I take ATK Damage.
monsters.explainer: 2 Thorns
monsters.flow: ATK 3, HP 5. Each time this owner receives ATK damage (including a killing blow), the player takes 2 ATK; block applies. Defeat and poison do not poke. Goblin-style immunity does not apply to this owner.
monsters.log_hint: Deals you 2 Atk dmg you when it takes Atk dmg
monsters.name: Needleback
monsters.notes: Portrait is a 0x72 wogol stand-in until a porcupine/toad tile exists.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, feed me one of two items.
monsters.explainer: Feed me one
monsters.flow: On spin, if you have 0 items, nothing. If 1, you must feed that one. If 2 or more, two random items are offered and you must feed one. The discard is not an item use. ATK/HP unchanged.
monsters.log_hint: Makes you feed it an item
monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.notes: Not an item use: no Kobold extra, no Echo update, no Harpy after the feed.
monsters.reminder: feed me one of two items

monsters.ability: I petrify your highest Attack item until you Spin again.
monsters.explainer: Petrify highest ATK
monsters.flow: After spin numbers, the highest Attack item in hand becomes Unplayable until the next Spin. Tie is random. No Attack items: nothing. Longbow and Spiked Shield count. Boot and Poison Flask do not. Smoke is a new Spin, so it clears. Attack still works. Cannot be Defeated unless Quiet Bell has silenced me.
monsters.name: Gargoyle
monsters.notes: Petrify tooltip: Unplayable until your next Spin.

monsters.ability: I attack you when your Spin lands on me, and after each item you use.
monsters.explainer: Interrupt 1 swing
monsters.flow: On spin, one swing of my current Attack (Block works). After each item fully resolves, if I am still alive, one more swing. Ceases when you click Done or I am Defeated/Slain. Done still takes the normal hit. Not Attack = Block.
monsters.log_hint: Hits on meet and after items
monsters.name: Harpy
monsters.notes: One swing, fight stays open. If an item already killed me, no extra swing.

monsters.ability: When I enter the Dungeon I Mark 2 other Monsters. Each time a Marked monster is Defeated, I gain +2 HP and ATK
monsters.explainer: On enter, Mark 2 other monsters. When one is Defeated, +2 HP and +2 ATK.
monsters.flow: On Done, swing count is 1 plus items used this fight. Cube feed does not count. Block is spent per swing.
monsters.name: Trapper
monsters.notes: 0 items = 1 swing. 2 items = 3 swings.

monsters.ability: If I live, I leave two Tough Monsters in my place.
monsters.explainer: Two Tough monsters if I live
monsters.flow: If you do not Defeat or Slay me, I leave and two random Tough monsters sit immediately, even if that grows the wheel past 8. You are not in a new fight yet.
monsters.name: Clockwork Knight
monsters.notes: Quiet Bell strips this: I leave like anyone else, no heirs.

monsters.ability: The first time you Spin me, I Flee and Petrify every other Item for 3 Spins.
monsters.explainer: First Spin: Flee, petrify 2nd, 4th, … for 3 Spins
monsters.flow: First Spin only. If Quiet Bell is on, I am a plain 4 ATK / 4 HP and the first time is spent. Otherwise Petrify every even-numbered item in the full hand, counting from the first position (2nd, 4th, 6th, …), with overlay and grey 3, then Flee (random Spin, I stay on the wheel). The follow-up Spin ticks 3 → 2. If that Spin lands me again, I stay and fight; first time is already used. Each Spin ticks petrify counts; at 0 they are clickable during that Spin before Gargoyle / Hydra. Later landings are a 4 / 4 fight. Fight only for the gaze. Decay (Zombie) is the old Famine rule.
monsters.log_hint: First Spin: Flee, petrify 2nd, 4th, … for 3 Spins
monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.notes: Bucket 7. Uses the old Basilisk sprite. Flee Shift line. Grey countdown on petrified items.

monsters.ability: Attack or Block values that are Even happen twice against me.
monsters.explainer: Even Attack or Block: twice
monsters.flow: While you fight me, an even Attack number hits me twice as two separate Attacks of that number. An even Block you gain while facing me is gained twice. Odd numbers happen once. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.name: Twins
monsters.notes: Anvil would take 1 from each of those two Attacks. Poison Flask is not an Attack.

monsters.ability: While I am in the Dungeon I will Always select a random Item. That Item is Discarded when you Spin me
monsters.explainer: Marks a random item. Spin this Beggar: that item is discarded.
monsters.flow: While I am alive in the dungeon I mark one random item, including curses, petrified cards, and Keep items. The slash and the mark happen when the fight can be played, before the first Spin, and again when I enter later. Using the marked item moves the mark. A Spin that lands on me discards that item even if it has Keep, then I mark another if I am still alive. If I leave without that Spin, the mark goes away and nothing is discarded. Quiet Bell clears the mark until the silence ends.
monsters.name: Beggar
monsters.notes: Keep does not save the item. Curses and unplayable items can be marked. A Decay link on the discarded item does not also discard the partner.

monsters.ability: I Lose 2 HP each time a Neighbor is Defeated
monsters.explainer: -2 HP per Neighbor Defeated.
monsters.flow: When a Neighbor's fight ends as Defeated, Slain, or Blocked, I lose 2 HP. Flee (Cowardly King, Commander) does not count. If this drops me to 0 HP, I am Defeated.
monsters.name: Wick

monsters.ability: I cannot lose more than 1 HP at a time.
monsters.explainer: Max 1 HP per source
monsters.flow: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source. Attack, Poison Flask, and other HP loss each chip 1. Defeat still works. Two separate Attacks chip 1 twice. Quiet Bell strips this, so full Attack lands.
monsters.log_hint: Loses only 1 HP at a time
monsters.name: Anvil
monsters.notes: Needleback poke is not an Item hitting me. Poison Flask is not an Attack. Extra Attacks each chip 1.

monsters.ability: When my Neighbors would take Attack Damage, I take it instead
monsters.explainer: Takes Neighbors' Attack damage
monsters.flow: When a neighbor would take Attack damage, I take that hit instead. Each Bodyguard does this once per hit, so a line of them passes it to the last Bodyguard. The pass is shown before HP changes. Double Axe adds my own hit and each neighbor's hit onto that end. If the hit was aimed at the Twins, the number doubles first. A hit aimed at Goblin still comes to me. If I die while I am not the one you are facing, I leave like a Crossbow kill. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.name: Bodyguard
monsters.notes: Bucket 3. Right is counterclockwise when a King is also passing. Goblin still shows Immune to Attack Damage when the hit actually lands on Goblin.

monsters.ability: Any time I lose HP, I command the monster to my right to Attack you immediately
monsters.explainer: When I lose HP, the monster on my right Attacks you.
monsters.flow: Whenever I lose HP (Attack, Poison Flask, Napalm, poison ticks), after the current item finishes, the living monster in the one seat counter-clockwise Attacks you the same way a Damsel neighbor Attacks. One loss event is one command, including a killing blow. Empty or dead right seat: nobody. Defeat items do not command. Hornet extra swings, Shambling falling apart, pierce, and current Attack all count. Spiked Flail or Needleback chipping me again commands again. Quiet Bell on me turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: Right monster Attacks when I lose HP
monsters.name: Petty King
monsters.notes: Bucket 6, tier 3. Id stays cowardly_king. Right is one seat counter-clockwise like Right Bracer. Any is plain English, not the Any-monster keyword.
monsters.reminder: When I lose HP, the monster on my right Attacks you.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, choose an Item and I will upgrade it
monsters.explainer: Choose an item. I upgrade it.
monsters.flow: After Spin, and after Spider Queen lays an egg, every item in hand that still has a remaining copy in this dungeon’s item pile of the next tier gets a button. That copy is used up. Tier 0 becomes Tier 1, Tier 1 becomes Tier 2, Tier 2 becomes Tier 3, Tier 3 stays Tier 3. You cannot go over a card’s copy count. You must pick one of those buttons before using items or Done. Clicking an item with nothing legal left leaves it as it is; you still pick a different item. If no item has a legal upgrade, nothing. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.name: Merchant
monsters.notes: Bucket 4. Remaining dungeon pile, that copy is used up. Two Sais is legal. A third is not. A new Spider Egg laid on this spin can be picked if a Tier 1 copy is still in the pile.
monsters.reminder: Choose an item. I upgrade it.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, Gain a Shield
monsters.explainer: Gain a Shield
monsters.flow: Only a real Spin onto me. I walk to the closest empty hotbar slot, you Gain a Shield (a fresh extra copy), then the bar re-sorts into the Block group. Grappling Hook and Damsel neighbors do not pay. Quiet Bell turns this off. Hand at 50: skip.
monsters.name: Juggernaut
monsters.notes: Bucket 8. The Shield is the live Shield card. You can click it this fight.
monsters.reminder: When you Spin me, Gain a Shield.

monsters.ability: After you Spin, if you are missing at least 3 HP I will Heal you for 3 and take your worst Item
monsters.explainer: After Spin: if missing 3 HP, Heal 3 and take worst item
monsters.flow: After every Spin while a living unsilenced Cleric is on the wheel. Automatic On Spin first (Cursed Scroll, Grief Jar, Harpy, poison, leech, Queen eggs, Juggernaut). Then if you are still alive and missing at least 3 HP, each Cleric in seat order: if still missing 3, Heal 3 and delete the lowest-tier item (ties random, Egg tier 0). Empty hand still Heals 3. Then Merchant or Cube may ask. Take, Done, and fight chips do not trigger this. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.name: Cleric
monsters.notes: Bucket 6. Spider Egg is Tier 0. Missing 3 HP means 3 hearts or fewer. Two Clerics: the second only pays if you are still missing 3 after the first Heal 3.
monsters.reminder: After you Spin, if missing 3 HP, Heal 3 and I take your worst item.

monsters.ability: When I lose HP or Attack, I die. My Neighbors each gain HP equal to my remaining HP.
monsters.explainer: On HP loss or Attack: I die. Neighbors gain my remaining HP
monsters.flow: SP-24 (2026-10-28). 7 HP / 0 Attack. I die on any HP loss (including poison ticks), when I would be Defeated, or when I Attack (0 Attack still Attacks). On death: each living Neighbor gains HP equal to my remaining HP measured after the loss that killed me (Attack / Defeat with HP still up uses the HP I still have). Gain grows max HP like Vampire. Empty seats skipped. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: Dies on HP loss or Attack; neighbors gain remaining HP
monsters.name: Martyr
monsters.notes: SP-24. Bucket 6. Wick, Berserker, Victory Flask, Mimic count this Defeat. Mimic does not gift because I already Attacked.
monsters.reminder: On HP loss or Attack: I die. Neighbors gain my remaining HP.

monsters.ability: When I would take Attack damage, both of my Neighbors take it instead.
monsters.explainer: Neighbors take my Attack damage
monsters.flow: When Attack would hit me, I take 0. Living neighbors take that Attack as if you attacked them, left (clockwise) first, then right. One living neighbor takes the full hit once. Zero living neighbors: I take it. A loop (two Prisms) fizzles that share. Needleback, Twins, Bodyguard, Goblin, Anvil apply on the one who actually takes it. Poison, Boot, Sledgehammer still hit me. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.name: Prism
monsters.notes: Bucket 4. Double Axe and bows still refract the share aimed at me.
monsters.reminder: Attack at me hits both neighbors instead.

monsters.ability: On Spin, my Neighbors Gain 2 Poison and Heal 2. While I live, Poison does not activate.
monsters.explainer: Spin: Neighbors +2 Poison and Heal 2. Poison frozen while I live.
monsters.flow: SP-28 (2026-10-28). On every Spin while I live unsilenced: each living Neighbor Gains 2 Poison and Heals 2 (cap at their max HP). Poison stacks keep growing. While I live unsilenced, Poison NEVER activates — monster poison and the player's poison both stay frozen. On the first Spin after I die (or Quiet Bell silences every living Plague Doctor), stored Poison activates normally. When Poison would activate but is blocked, show my slash portrait and the dissolving line 'Poison does not activate'.
monsters.log_hint: Neighbors +2 Poison and Heal 2; Poison frozen while alive
monsters.name: Plague Doctor
monsters.notes: SP-28. Bucket 5. Freeze-all poison while alive (player + monsters). Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.reminder: On Spin: Neighbors Gain 2 Poison and Heal 2. Poison does not activate while I live.

monsters.ability: If you Discard an item when facing me, I will Attack one of my Neighbors and Flee.
monsters.explainer: Discard an item: I Attack a Neighbor and Flee.
monsters.flow: After Spin, overlay. Click any card in hand (Hex, Potion, Egg, Marble, petrified) to Discard it. That is not an item use. I deal my Attack to one living Neighbor at random (Pocketwatch rules: Needleback hits me). Then I Flee. No living Neighbors: Decline only, I do not Flee. Empty hand: overlay, Decline only, then a snarky line and we fight. Quiet Bell turns this off. Decline: snark, then ordinary combat.
monsters.log_hint: Pay an item, I hit a Neighbor and Flee
monsters.name: Hired Hand
monsters.notes: Bucket 6. Flee keeps the live tooltip.
monsters.reminder: Discard an item: I Attack a Neighbor and Flee.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, I Petrify all Items with an Even Atk or Blk value and Gain +2 Atk for each
monsters.explainer: Petrify even Attack and Block. +2 Attack each.
monsters.flow: When you Spin me (same moment as Gargoyle, before Queen eggs and Juggernaut Shield): look at the live Attack or Block number on each item in hand. Egg counts. 0 is even. Heal, Defeat, Poison, Hex, Potion, Bag, Magnet, and Smoke do not. Even numbers are Petrified (Unplayable until your next Spin, same overlay as Gargoyle). Then I Gain +2 Attack for each item petrified this landing. That Attack stays on me for the dungeon and stacks if you Spin me again. Quiet Bell after I fired: I keep the Attack; I will not Petrify or Gain on a later landing. Quiet Bell before I fire: this landing does nothing.
monsters.name: Hydra
monsters.notes: Bucket 7. Petrify tooltip is Gargoyle’s: Unplayable until your next Spin.
monsters.reminder: Petrify even Attack and Block. +2 Attack each.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, I Decay two of your Items.
monsters.explainer: Decay two of your Items
monsters.flow: SP-25 (2026-10-25). When you Spin me, I Decay up to two random Items that do not already have Keep. Decayed Items are linked. When you use one, Keep it and discard the other. The discarded Item counts as a discard (Recycler and the same discard path as Hired Hand). If only one eligible Item, Decay that one: using it Keeps it, and there is no partner. If a Decayed Item is not used this combat, discard it. Other Items work normally. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.name: Zombie
monsters.notes: SP-25. Keyword Decay. Unused Decayed Items are discarded.
monsters.reminder: Decayed Items are linked. When you use one, Keep it and discard the other.

monsters.ability: If I have 3 HP, I am Defeated. If I would be Defeated in any other way, I instead lose 2 HP and Flee.
monsters.explainer: 3 HP: Defeated. Else Defeat: −2 HP and Flee
monsters.flow: If my HP is exactly 3, I am Defeated (loot). If something else would Defeat or Slay me (0 HP, Boot, Hex), I instead lose 2 HP from the HP I had before that Defeat and Flee. After that Flee, if I have 3 HP, I am Defeated. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: 3 HP dies. Other Defeat: −2 and Flee
monsters.name: Triclops
monsters.notes: Bucket 5. New Triclops. Needs new art. 3-Seeker keeps Triple Threat.

monsters.ability: I Attack repeatedly until I die. I lose 1 HP each time I Attack.
monsters.explainer: I Attack repeatedly until I die. I lose 1 HP each time I Attack.
monsters.flow: On any Attack this monster makes (Done, Damsel neighbor, Pocketwatch), it swings, then loses 1 of its own HP, then swings again until that HP is 0. Swing count is remaining HP. ATK stays 1 (Commander still adds). Block leftover carries like Hornet. Quiet Bell: one swing, no HP loss. Flee skips the Attack, so they do not fall apart. Self HP loss is not your Attack (no Needleback, Twins, Prism). Hitting 0 is a normal Defeat with loot. Plate badge is ∞; Shift uses remaining HP. SP-27 (2026-10-28). HP is 6 (was 4). Behavior otherwise unchanged.
monsters.log_hint: Attacks until it dies; loses 1 HP per Attack
monsters.name: Shambling Mound
monsters.notes: SP-27. Bucket 4. Walking moss heap. Like Hornet with ∞ swings. Any Attack, then Defeat with loot. HP 6 (babySlime Boss).

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, you may Discard Items. Each sacrifice reduces my Atk and HP by 3.
monsters.explainer: When you Spin me, you may Discard Items. Each sacrifice reduces my Atk and HP by 3.
monsters.flow: After Spin, overlay like Hired Hand. Click any card in hand (Hex, Potion, Egg, Marble, petrified) one at a time to Discard it; that is not an item use. Each Discard: I lose 3 Attack and 3 HP, and those numbers stay on this slice for later Spins. Continue ends the overlay and you fight at the numbers left. If HP hits 0 from a Discard, I am Defeated (loot, empty seat) and combat ends. Empty hand: Continue only, then 9/9. Quiet Bell: no overlay. Grappling Hook and Damsel neighbors are not a Spin. Commander +2 still applies after the −3.
monsters.log_hint: Discard items: I lose 3 Attack and 3 HP each
monsters.name: Almighty Worm
monsters.notes: Bucket 3. Sand worm. Overlay + Continue. Stats stay reduced.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me or my Neighbor, Gain 1 Blood Pact
monsters.explainer: When you Spin me or my Neighbor, Gain 1 Blood Pact
monsters.flow: After Spin, each living Cultist who is not silenced grants 1 Blood Pact if you landed on them or on a monster sitting next to them. Two Cultists who both qualify grant two. Full hand: skip. Quiet Bell on the Cultist: that Cultist does not grant. Quiet Bell on their neighbor: they still grant. Grappling Hook and Damsel neighbors are not a Spin. Token is not loot. Then the fight happens as usual.
monsters.log_hint: Spin me or my neighbor: Gain Blood Pact
monsters.name: Cultist
monsters.notes: Bucket 8. Hooded robe. One pact per qualifying Cultist.

monsters.ability: After each Item you use while facing me, swap my HP and Attack.
monsters.explainer: After each Item while facing me: swap my HP and Attack
monsters.flow: SP-20 (2026-10-28). 6 HP / 5 Attack. After each Item you use while facing me (the same uses that increment items_used_this_combat), swap my current HP and Attack. If that item drops me to 0 HP, I die and do NOT swap. Quiet Bell: no swap. Replaces Patient Disarm (second-item dummy).
monsters.log_hint: After each item: swap HP and Attack
monsters.name: Bushido
monsters.notes: SP-20. Bucket 3. After each counted item use while facing me unsilenced, swap current HP and Attack. If that item drops me to 0 HP I die and do not swap. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.reminder: After each Item while facing me: swap my HP and Attack.

monsters.ability: I Attack until you lose HP
monsters.explainer: I Attack until you lose HP
monsters.flow: On any Attack this monster makes (Done, Damsel neighbor, Pocketwatch), it keeps swinging until you lose any HP this Attack. Prior HP loss this fight does not count. Quiet Bell: one swing even if leftover is 0. Net leftover 0: Attack 5 times for 0, then unique dialogue 'Oh, so it's gonna be like that, huh? Wow. What a way to die.' then SLAIN (not BLOCKED), with loot. Pocketwatch: keep hitting the facing enemy until that enemy loses HP; Goblin and unhittable: one swing and stop, Shark is not slain. Plate badge is a loop mark, not ∞.
monsters.name: Shark

monsters.ability: When I Spawn, Gain 1 Toll. On Spin, I lose 2 HP. When I am Defeated, Discard 1 Item.
monsters.explainer: When I Spawn, Gain 1 Toll. On Spin, I lose 2 HP. When I am Defeated, Discard 1 Item.
monsters.flow: When this slice is added to the wheel (Place, Challenge fill, Clockwork heir, Developer Test), Gain 1 Toll at 6 even if Zombie would block Gain. If the hand is full, the player clicks one item to throw away, then Toll lands. A second Death Bell grants a second Toll at 6. On Spin of this monster, if it is not silenced, it loses 2 HP (Anvil still max 1). Quiet Bell: skip the -2 HP and skip the Defeat discard; Tolls already in hand still tick. Item uses that already increment Beads (including Bushido's dummy throw) tick every Toll by 1. Potion auto, Buckler auto, and Cube/Worm/overlay picks do not tick. At Toll 1 the card pulses. At 0 they Die; Healing Potion can save. If the killing item ticks Toll from 1 to 0 while this Bell is the one being Defeated, the Defeat discard overlay happens first so they can throw Toll away and live. Defeat overlay: must click one item (Ability as the line), then the Bell rings and leaves with loot. Empty hand: skip discard, still ring. Toll is T0, black like Egg, Unplayable, not drafted.
monsters.log_hint: Spawn Toll. Spin -2 HP. Defeat: Discard 1 Item.
monsters.name: Death Bell

monsters.ability: If you have 3, 6, or 9 Items, you Always Spin me next

monsters.flow: On any Spin (mill random, Challenge click, Flee, Magnet, Smoke), if a living unsilenced 3-Seeker is on the wheel and your hand has exactly 3, 6, or 9 items, land on a random living 3-Seeker. Smoke’s skip loses. Quiet Bell: no steal. Tutorial forced Spin still wins. Glow those slices while you are ready to Spin. Challenge: if you clicked a non-3-Seeker, 3-Seeker says “Sorry, this fight is mine now” then you fight them.

If Defeated before I Attack (has_attacked is still false: Attack damage or a defeat item, and also a skip that never lets me Attack), add a Phoenix Egg to the top of the Dungeon Deck. Block-then-I-Attack does not lay an egg. The egg goes on top of the Dungeon Deck. Challenge and Adventure seat it with normal hole fill and loot. The mill does not draw that deck, so the egg is installed into the vacated seat. Phoenix Egg still hatches into a Phoenix. Quiet Bell turns this off.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, if my Attack would kill you, I Flee and lose 1 Attack
monsters.explainer: If Take would drop you to 0 HP, I lose 1 Attack and Flee instead of hitting you.
monsters.flow: After every On Spin effect, if you are facing me and I am not silenced, look at the Take button's damage. That includes Block (Stone Wall included), Rust, pierce, and Double Buckler if it would halve an even Attack. Do not spend those items. A Healing Potion does not count as surviving. If that damage would leave you at 0 HP, I do not hit you. My Attack goes down by 1, not below 0, and stays down on this copy. Then Flee: I stay on the wheel, and the wheel spins at random. If that spin lands on me and Take would still drop you to 0, I do it again until a landing would leave you at 1 HP or more. Ball and Chain stops the Flee. I still lose the 1 Attack, and the fight stays open so you can play cards. Take uses the new Attack. Quiet Bell turns the check off. Attack I already lost stays lost.
monsters.log_hint: Lethal Take: lose 1 Attack and Flee

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, I transform a random Attack or Block Item into a Poison Flask of equal value
monsters.explainer: On Spin: one Attack or Block Item becomes a Poison Flask of that number
monsters.flow: On a real Spin onto me, after Cleric and the other On Spin changes, if I am not silenced and poison did not already drop me to 0: pick one Attack or Block item still in hand at random. Chakram counts once and its number is 3. Chain uses Block already restored this Spin, including Stone Wall, and is 0 when Block is 0. Arrow Head is 6 and does not copy the HP loss. Helmet and Spiked Shield use the hand after Cleric's take. The number is copied once. Change that card in place into a Poison Flask with that poison number. Not an item use. Recycler does not tick. You can click a flask of 0: pick a living neighbor, add 0 Poison, and the card is used up. A higher flask is the same click. Plague Doctor uses the live poison rules.
monsters.log_hint: On Spin: one Attack or Block Item becomes a Poison Flask
